project.name: zalo-assistant-bot
project.description: A Zalo assistant bot built on the Zalo Bot Platform that replies in group chats using Google Gemini, with polling-based updates and an optional desktop management app. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Loads bot Settings from environment variables and the settings.env file, with typed helpers and validation errors surfaced as user-readable messages.

nodes.name: process_lock.py
nodes.summary: Single-instance file lock preventing two bot processes from running on the same data directory.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the system subpackage.

nodes.name: auto_update.py
nodes.summary: Source-install auto-updater: checks pending git commits, runs git pull, reinstalls dependencies when needed and reports the result.

nodes.name: bot_process.py
nodes.summary: Manages background bot and admin processes using lock and PID files, systemd on VPS, standby flags and status reporting shared by CLI and web UI.

nodes.name: first_run_setup.py
nodes.summary: First-run preparation of the userdata directory, creating missing folders and template files and generating a random admin token.

nodes.name: handover.py
nodes.summary: Builds and imports zip bundles of bot data to migrate the bot between local machine and VPS, validating entry names and sizes before writing.

nodes.name: handover_job.py
nodes.summary: Background job orchestrating a bot transfer between local and VPS: precheck, stop old side, copy data, start new side, rollback on failure.

nodes.name: remote_config.py
nodes.summary: Applies bot settings pushed from the owner web, caches them locally, and sends a per-minute heartbeat with the last error.

nodes.name: ConfigError
nodes.summary: Exception for missing or invalid configuration with a message ready to show to users.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding all bot settings with from_env loading and a check for required secrets before a command runs.

nodes.name: AlreadyRunning
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the instance lock is already held.

nodes.name: InstanceLock
nodes.summary: File lock that acquires exclusive ownership of a data directory, optionally retrying for a wait period.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Performs the git pull update, reinstalls pip dependencies if changed, and returns an UpdateResult.

nodes.name: pending_commits
nodes.summary: Counts new GitHub commits not yet present locally after a git fetch.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts the bot process (systemd service on VPS, hidden spawn otherwise) and returns a Result.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops the bot process, killing the supervisor first so it does not respawn.

nodes.name: status_info
nodes.summary: Returns bot status as data for the gateway status command and Overview page.

nodes.name: ensure_home
nodes.summary: Creates missing userdata folders and template files without overwriting, returning the created files.

nodes.name: ensure_admin_token
nodes.summary: Generates a random admin token and saves it to .env when none exists so the UI never runs unprotected.

nodes.name: export_bundle
nodes.summary: Writes the data zip bundle to a destination and returns its manifest.

nodes.name: validate_bundle
nodes.summary: Checks each zip entry name and size before anything is written.

nodes.name: import_bundle
nodes.summary: Replaces local data with a bundle, refusing if the bot is running and keeping a backup.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts a background transfer to vps or local, raising JobError if busy or target invalid.

nodes.name: precheck
nodes.summary: Returns non-blocking warnings or raises JobError if the transfer cannot proceed.

nodes.name: RemoteConfig
nodes.summary: Holds the latest web-supplied configuration, applies overrides via a callback, and writes web-set SYSTEM.md and MEMORY.md with backups.

nodes.name: RemoteSync
nodes.summary: Sends a per-minute heartbeat and fetches new config; network errors are logged only.

nodes.name: remote_server.py
nodes.summary: HTTP client from the local app to the VPS admin server using REMOTE_URL and admin token, with sync and async helpers and user-friendly RemoteError.

nodes.name: server_info.py
nodes.summary: Read-only collection of host info (uptime, memory, git commit, latest remote commit, systemd state) for the Server page.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the admin UI subpackage.

nodes.name: admin_sessions.py
nodes.summary: In-memory Gmail login sessions and device-key registry for the admin web server, with 12-hour expiry.

nodes.name: admin_web_server.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI admin server bound to localhost, exposing authenticated /api routes for settings, bot control, VPS connection, handover, history and logs with DNS-rebinding and origin protections.

nodes.name: settings_file.py
nodes.summary: Reads and atomically writes the .env settings file preserving comments, validating changes through Settings and backing up to .env.bak.

nodes.name: desktop_app.py
nodes.summary: Windows desktop management app showing the admin UI in a WebView2 window with a tray icon, single-instance behavior, and update and handover actions.

nodes.name: userdata_paths.py
nodes.summary: Defines APP_HOME and userdata folder layout constants, plus legacy-data migration into userdata/.

nodes.name: call_sync
nodes.summary: Calls the VPS and returns JSON, raising RemoteError with a Vietnamese message on failure.

nodes.name: stream
nodes.summary: Streams bytes such as live logs from the VPS, raising before the first byte if unreachable.

nodes.name: collect
nodes.summary: Aggregates uptime, memory, code version, systemd state and last update run into a dict for the Server page.

nodes.name: AdminSessions
nodes.summary: In-memory store of random Gmail-login session tokens with 12-hour expiry.

nodes.name: AdminDevices
nodes.summary: Registry of device keys that let remote apps control this admin page after Gmail login.

nodes.name: AdminContext
nodes.summary: Request context that rereads the .env on each request so Settings changes apply immediately.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Builds the FastAPI app with auth, host and origin middleware and all /api routes for settings, bot control, VPS connection, handover, history and logs.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Writes validated changes into .env keeping comments, backing up to .env.bak with an atomic write.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Cleans and validates changes using the Settings.from_env rules of the bot.

nodes.name: Desktop
nodes.summary: Desktop app controller: runs or reuses the admin server, shows a WebView2 window and tray, and offers handover, update and folder-open actions.

nodes.name: run_gui
nodes.summary: Entry point that launches the desktop management app.

nodes.name: app_home
nodes.summary: Resolves APP_HOME, the directory holding userdata and code, for frozen and source runs.

nodes.name: migrate_legacy
nodes.summary: Moves legacy .env, data, logs, workspace and tools into userdata and returns what moved.

nodes.name: assign_events.py
nodes.summary: Agent tool module that lets the bot assign, update, cancel and list calendar events for people mentioned in a Zalo group, delegating to an external schedule web app via server_client. Resolves recipients from @mentions or accent-insensitive name matching and remembers assigned events in a JSONL file.

nodes.name: match_member
nodes.summary: Matches a name against a chat member map using accent-insensitive exact, whole-word, then prefix comparison and returns the matching user IDs.

nodes.name: resolve_people
nodes.summary: Resolves event recipients from real @mentions first, then names and teams, returning the resolved {zaloUid,name} list plus unresolved names.

nodes.name: _assign
nodes.summary: Tool handler that creates an event via the schedule web API for the resolved recipients, enforcing role permissions, and records it locally.

nodes.name: _update
nodes.summary: Tool handler that patches a previously assigned event (time, title, add/remove recipients), defaulting to the most recent event in the chat.

nodes.name: _tools
nodes.summary: Builds the Tool definitions (giao_lich, sua_lich, huy_lich, lich_cua_toi, lich_da_giao) with JSON schemas, returning none when the schedule server is not configured.

nodes.name: read_chat_memory.py
nodes.summary: Agent tool that lets the model re-read recent raw messages of the current conversation from memorydata, optionally filtered by keyword. The chat id comes from the tool context so other conversations cannot be read.

nodes.name: _read
nodes.summary: Handler that loads recent memory records for the current chat, filters by accent-folded keyword, and formats them with Vietnam-time stamps and a note marking them as data only.

nodes.name: message_filter.py
nodes.summary: Layered message filter deciding whether a Zalo message is addressed to the bot, using rules (private chat, /bot, mention, name call), group mode and token budget, and finally an AI classification.

nodes.name: Decision
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a filter verdict (reply flag, reason, layer) with a method to convert it into a log record.

nodes.name: MessageFilter
nodes.summary: Applies the filter tiers to incoming messages: strips triggers and self-mentions, detects calls to the bot, and asks the AI to decide in all-mode groups.

nodes.name: message_handler.py
nodes.summary: Core Bot orchestrator that receives Zalo payloads, applies filtering, roles, rate limiting and budgets, queues jobs per chat, runs the agent, and sends chunked replies with mention tags.

nodes.name: ZaloSender
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the Zalo sending interface (send_message, send_chat_action) that the bot depends on.

nodes.name: Job
nodes.summary: Dataclass representing a queued message-processing job.

nodes.name: Bot
nodes.summary: Main bot class: handles payloads, owner commands, filtering, per-chat worker queues, agent calls, usage tracking and replies, with drain/stop lifecycle control.

nodes.name: strip_name_prefix
nodes.summary: Removes a leading bot-name prefix from a line of text.

nodes.name: owner_commands.py
nodes.summary: Parses and executes in-chat slash commands (help, mode, allow, deny, status, reset, leader, team, role) gated by user role, operating on group, history and usage stores.

nodes.name: help_text
nodes.summary: Renders the list of commands available to a given role.

nodes.name: parse_command
nodes.summary: Parses a message into a ParsedCommand if it starts with a known slash command.

nodes.name: describe_mode
nodes.summary: Returns a human-readable description of a group filter mode.

nodes.name: ParsedCommand
nodes.summary: Dataclass for a parsed command name and its arguments.

nodes.name: CommandHandler
nodes.summary: Executes parsed commands after checking role requirements, updating group state, leaders, teams and resetting history.

nodes.name: _pick_people
nodes.summary: Selects people from mentions or names in a command message for leader/team operations.

nodes.name: rate_limiter.py
nodes.summary: In-memory sliding-window rate limiter limiting messages per minute per key.

nodes.name: RateLimiter
nodes.summary: Tracks per-key hit timestamps in a deque and allows or rejects within a 60-second window; zero disables limiting.

nodes.name: reply_formatting.py
nodes.summary: Reply text helpers: UTF-16 length counting, splitting long messages into chunks, and converting markdown to plain text for Zalo.

nodes.name: split_message
nodes.summary: Splits a long reply into chunks under a UTF-16 length limit, preferring natural break points.

nodes.name: roles.py
nodes.summary: Defines the basic < leader < owner role hierarchy with labels, role lookup per chat, and permission checks for commands.

nodes.name: role_of
nodes.summary: Determines a user role (owner, group leader or basic) in a chat.

nodes.name: required_role
nodes.summary: Maps a command name and arguments to the minimum role required.

nodes.name: text_fold.py
nodes.summary: Tiny helper that folds Vietnamese text to lowercase accent-free form for matching.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Storage package barrel re-exporting data stores and text file helpers.

nodes.name: data_stores.py
nodes.summary: Persistent per-chat stores for group state, seen messages, history, memory data, usage, stats, activity and failed messages, built on JSONL/JSON files.

nodes.name: GroupStore
nodes.summary: File-backed store of group state (allowed, mode, label, leaders, teams) with mtime-based reload and leader/assign permission checks.

nodes.name: HistoryStore
nodes.summary: Per-chat conversation history stored as JSONL with append, recent and clear.

nodes.name: MemoryDataStore
nodes.summary: Records all messages of a chat (user and model) for later recall by the memory tool.

nodes.name: UsageStore
nodes.summary: Tracks daily token usage per chat and a notified flag for budget limits.

nodes.name: FailedStore
nodes.summary: Queue of failed messages that can be listed pending and marked done.

nodes.name: text_files.py
nodes.summary: Low-level file helpers: atomic text writing and JSONL / JSON object file wrappers with append, tail, trim and rewrite.

nodes.name: atomic_write_text
nodes.summary: Writes text to a temp file and atomically replaces the target to avoid partial writes.

nodes.name: JsonLinesFile
nodes.summary: Wrapper around a JSON Lines file offering read_all, append, rewrite, tail, count and trim.

nodes.name: JsonObjectFile
nodes.summary: Wrapper around a single JSON object file with read and atomic write.

nodes.name: receive_webhook.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI webhook receiver for Zalo that validates the secret-token header and queues messages for handling, replying immediately.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Creates the FastAPI app with the Zalo webhook route, verifying the secret header with constant-time compare and dispatching payloads to the handler.

nodes.name: __main__.py
nodes.summary: Module entry point enabling `python -m bot`, delegating to the command-line main.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package init that re-exports the agent classes, prompt builder and tool registry.

nodes.name: gemini_agent.py
nodes.summary: Gemini-backed agent that runs a bounded function-calling loop with retries on transient errors, plus a JSON classifier for message filtering and an echo fallback agent.
nodes.languageNotes: Async code using dataclasses and a typing Protocol; Vietnamese user-facing strings.

nodes.name: Turn
nodes.summary: Immutable dataclass for one conversation turn (role, text, optional speaker name).

nodes.name: ToolStep
nodes.summary: Immutable record of one tool invocation with name, args, result and elapsed milliseconds.

nodes.name: AgentReply
nodes.summary: Immutable result of an agent call: reply text, token count, tool steps, model and latency.

nodes.name: Agent
nodes.summary: Protocol defining the async reply interface agents must implement.

nodes.name: _usage_tokens
nodes.summary: Extracts total token count from a Gemini response usage metadata, defaulting to zero.

nodes.name: _rejects_thinking
nodes.summary: Detects an HTTP 400 error caused by a model not supporting the thinking parameter.

nodes.name: _is_transient
nodes.summary: Decides whether an exception is a network transport error or a 5xx server error worth retrying.

nodes.name: GeminiAgent
nodes.summary: Calls Gemini with tool declarations, executes requested tools via the registry for up to a max number of rounds, and offers a low-thinking JSON classify call; supports live reconfiguration and retries.

nodes.name: EchoAgent
nodes.summary: Fake agent for console mode without an API key: echoes the last message and declines to run the AI filter.

nodes.name: system_prompt.py
nodes.summary: Builds the system prompt from hot-reloaded SYSTEM.md and MEMORY.md plus runtime context (Vietnam time, chat type, tools, members, sender role).

nodes.name: _CachedFile
nodes.summary: Reads a text file, strips HTML comments, and re-reads only when its modification time changes.

nodes.name: PromptBuilder
nodes.summary: Assembles the full system prompt: base instructions, context section, group-mention and role-permission rules, and long-term memory framed as data.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Tool registry package: defines ToolContext, Tool and ToolRegistry, and auto-discovers tool modules (built-in and user-supplied) that expose a TOOLS list.

nodes.name: ToolContext
nodes.summary: Immutable per-message context handed to tools (chat, user, role, mentions, members, teams, data dir).

nodes.name: Tool
nodes.summary: Immutable tool definition with name, description, handler, JSON-schema parameters and owner-only flag.

nodes.name: ToolRegistry
nodes.summary: Holds tools by name, rejects duplicates, emits Gemini declarations, and calls tools safely with owner checks and error capture returned as dicts.

nodes.name: _load_external
nodes.summary: Dynamically imports user-written .py tool files from a directory and registers their TOOLS, logging failures instead of crashing.

nodes.name: discover
nodes.summary: Scans the tools package and the external user tools directory to build a populated ToolRegistry.

nodes.name: _example.py
nodes.summary: Template tool (not auto-loaded due to leading underscore) showing how to declare a current_time tool via TOOLS.

nodes.name: _current_time
nodes.summary: Tool handler returning the current Vietnam date and time with UTC+7 timezone.

nodes.name: command_line.py
nodes.summary: Main CLI for the bot: argparse subcommands (run, gui, console, login, update, admin, health, etc.), agent construction, bot startup and console chat simulation.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes async runtime with sync helpers; handles frozen-exe console attachment on Windows.

nodes.name: _build_agent
nodes.summary: Discovers tools and builds a GeminiAgent from settings, or an EchoAgent when no API key is set in echo mode.

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Async main runtime that wires the Zalo client, stores, message handler and admin server, then runs the bot until shutdown.

nodes.name: _start_server_sync
nodes.summary: Starts the admin web server synchronously.

nodes.name: _bot_status
nodes.summary: Builds a status dictionary of model, token usage, message counts, pending failures and last error.

nodes.name: _console
nodes.summary: Interactive terminal chat loop that feeds user input to the bot through ConsoleZalo.

nodes.name: _zalo_call
nodes.summary: Runs a single Zalo API call for the me/webhook subcommands.

nodes.name: _health
nodes.summary: Performs a health check of the bot and returns an exit code.

nodes.name: _zalo_login
nodes.summary: Drives QR login for a personal Zalo account from the command line and saves the session.

nodes.name: _update
nodes.summary: Handles the self-update subcommand.

nodes.name: _admin
nodes.summary: Runs admin-related subcommands for the web admin interface.

nodes.name: _prepare_home
nodes.summary: Prepares the application home directory, including legacy user data migration.

nodes.name: _utf8_console
nodes.summary: Forces UTF-8 on stdout/stderr for Vietnamese output.

nodes.name: _attach_parent_console
nodes.summary: Attaches to the parent console on Windows when running as a frozen exe.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses CLI arguments and dispatches to the matching subcommand, returning a process exit code.

nodes.name: ConsoleZalo
nodes.summary: Fake Zalo client that prints bot replies to the terminal for console mode.

nodes.name: vietnam_time.py
nodes.summary: Vietnam time helpers using a fixed UTC+7 timezone: epoch milliseconds, current datetime and ISO date.

nodes.name: now_ms
nodes.summary: Returns current epoch time in milliseconds.

nodes.name: now_vn
nodes.summary: Returns the current timezone-aware datetime in Vietnam (UTC+7).

nodes.name: today_vn
nodes.summary: Returns the Vietnam date for today as an ISO string.

nodes.name: log_files.py
nodes.summary: Configures root logging to console and a rotating file, with a filter that masks secrets and quieting of noisy HTTP libraries.

nodes.name: RedactFilter
nodes.summary: Logging filter that replaces configured secrets with *** in messages and exception text.

nodes.name: setup_logging
nodes.summary: Installs console and rotating file handlers with redaction on the root logger and raises noisy library log levels.

nodes.name: qr_login.py
nodes.summary: Implements Zalo personal-account login via QR code (following zca-js flow) with synchronous requests, status reporting, cancellation and session persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: Synchronous requests-based flow intended to run in a worker thread; cancel uses threading.Event.

nodes.name: QrLoginError
nodes.summary: Base exception for QR login failures.

nodes.name: Cancelled
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the QR login is cancelled.

nodes.name: ZaloSession
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding an authenticated Zalo session (cookies, IMEI, display name) with save-to-file.

nodes.name: QrStatus
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing current QR login state, message and QR image for UI display.

nodes.name: make_imei
nodes.summary: Generates a Zalo Web style IMEI from a uuid4 and the MD5 of the user agent.

nodes.name: cookies_for
nodes.summary: Flattens a cookie jar into a dict for a host, choosing the most specific domain on name collisions.

nodes.name: QrLogin
nodes.summary: Runs a single QR login: fetches QR, waits for scan and confirmation, follows session redirects, verifies user info and reports status updates; cancellable from another thread.

nodes.name: save_qr_png
nodes.summary: Decodes a base64 QR image and writes it as a PNG file.

nodes.name: apply_session
nodes.summary: Saves the logged-in session and sets RECEIVE_MODE=personal in the .env file.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Shared pytest fixtures and fakes (FakeZalo, FakeAgent, FakeWeb) plus helpers to build Settings, Zalo webhook events and a Bot wired with test doubles.

nodes.name: test_bot.py
nodes.summary: Large behavioral test suite for the Bot message handler covering trigger/mode rules, owner and role commands, allow/deny lists, dedupe, rate limits, budgets, retries, message splitting, history, mentions and leader assignment.

nodes.name: test_desktop.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the desktop packaging layer: app home resolution (source/frozen), hidden subprocess windows, home bootstrap, admin token, gateway shutdown, logging, free-port picking, autostart registry, tray actions, icons and secret scanning.

nodes.name: test_filter.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the message filter that decides whether the bot should reply, using rules first and a Gemini classifier fallback with retries, budget handling and error logging.

nodes.name: test_memorydata.py
nodes.summary: Tests that every message is logged to per-chat memory data, disallowed chats are skipped, the store trims to its limit and the history tool only reads its own chat.

nodes.name: test_personal.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the personal Zalo account backend using a fake zlapi client: session loading, message mapping, thread types, listener dispatch, network error detection, mention building and tag handling.

nodes.name: test_remote_config.py
nodes.summary: Tests for the web-linked remote features: whitelisted config pulled from the web, live apply and caching, heartbeat tolerance of network errors, batched session upload and link-code handling.

nodes.name: FakeZalo
nodes.summary: In-memory Zalo client double that records sent messages and can fail a configurable number of sends with a ZaloError to exercise retry logic.

nodes.name: FakeAgent
nodes.summary: Agent double returning a canned reply and token count, recording reply and classify calls, with configurable filter verdict or error.

nodes.name: FakeWeb
nodes.summary: Fake web backend for /api/agent/* implemented as an httpx handler with route table, Bearer key check, offline mode and call recording.

nodes.name: make_settings
nodes.summary: Builds a Settings object from a minimal env pointing data, workspace and log dirs into tmp_path, with rate limits and budget disabled and optional overrides.

nodes.name: event
nodes.summary: Creates a Zalo webhook event payload for a text message with sender, chat, unique message id and timestamp defaults.

nodes.name: make_bot
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture returning a factory that builds a Bot with test settings, fake Zalo and agent, and a PromptBuilder.

nodes.name: web
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture that patches httpx.AsyncClient with a MockTransport to FakeWeb and sets schedule API env vars and APP_HOME.

nodes.name: mention_tags.py
nodes.summary: Handles @mention tagging in Zalo groups: inserts missing @ before member names the requester asked to tag, and converts @Name text into Zalo mention objects using accent-insensitive, word-boundary matching with UTF-16 offsets.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses fold-to-same-length normalization so positions in folded text map back to the original string.

nodes.name: fold_same_length
nodes.summary: Strips diacritics and lowercases text while keeping each character one character long so match indexes stay valid.

nodes.name: utf16_len
nodes.summary: Returns length in UTF-16 code units, matching how Zalo/JavaScript counts mention positions.

nodes.name: _names
nodes.summary: Builds a list of (folded name, uid) pairs from members, skipping very short names and sorting longest first.

nodes.name: _find
nodes.summary: Finds the first occurrence of a folded name at word boundaries.

nodes.name: build_mentions
nodes.summary: Scans text for @ followed by a known member name and returns Zalo mention dicts with pos, len, uid and type.

nodes.name: add_tags
nodes.summary: If the request shows tag/call intent, inserts @ before member names mentioned in both request and reply, avoiding overlaps with longer names.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package initializer re-exporting the Zalo client, error type, incoming message model and update parser.

nodes.name: bot_platform_api.py
nodes.summary: Async httpx client for the Zalo Bot Platform HTTP API, wrapping getMe, getUpdates, sendMessage, webhook methods, and redacting the bot token from errors.

nodes.name: ZaloError
nodes.summary: Exception for Zalo API failures or network errors carrying description, error code and a network flag.

nodes.name: ZaloClient
nodes.summary: Posts JSON calls to the Zalo Bot API with token-redacted error handling and convenience methods for polling, sending messages, typing action and webhooks.

nodes.name: incoming_message.py
nodes.summary: Defines the IncomingMessage dataclass and parsers that normalize Zalo webhook/getUpdates payloads into messages, including timestamp normalization and a dedupe key.

nodes.name: IncomingMessage
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a received chat message with group/text helpers and a dedupe key based on message id or content hash.

nodes.name: _to_ms
nodes.summary: Converts a timestamp to milliseconds, treating small values as seconds.

nodes.name: parse_event
nodes.summary: Converts one Zalo event dict into an IncomingMessage, returning None if chat or sender id is missing.

nodes.name: parse_updates
nodes.summary: Accepts a webhook payload or getUpdates result in several shapes and returns a list of valid messages.

nodes.name: personal_account.py
nodes.summary: Runs the bot on a personal Zalo account through the unofficial zlapi library: session loading, websocket listening in a thread, message conversion, group member lookup for tagging, and sending with mentions.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges a synchronous library to asyncio via a listener thread, run_coroutine_threadsafe and asyncio.to_thread.

nodes.name: load_session
nodes.summary: Reads the saved login session file in several formats and returns cookies, IMEI and user agent, raising ConfigError with guidance otherwise.

nodes.name: to_incoming
nodes.summary: Converts zlapi onMessage arguments into an IncomingMessage, flagging own messages as bot to avoid self-replies.

nodes.name: _mention_list
nodes.summary: Normalizes a message mentions field (JSON string or list) into valid mention dicts.

nodes.name: mention_names
nodes.summary: Extracts a uid-to-name map from @tags in a message using UTF-16 offsets, skipping @All.

nodes.name: _import_zlapi
nodes.summary: Lazily imports zlapi, raising ConfigError with install instructions if missing.

nodes.name: PersonalZalo
nodes.summary: Personal-account Zalo transport with login, threaded websocket listening, group member caching, and send_message/send_chat_action compatible with ZaloClient.

nodes.name: _is_network_error
nodes.summary: Walks the exception cause chain to decide whether a failure is a network error.

nodes.name: _log_failure
nodes.summary: Done-callback that logs exceptions from handler futures.

nodes.name: receive_polling.py
nodes.summary: Long-polling receive loop using getUpdates with webhook removal, exponential backoff, log-spam suppression and heartbeat state updates.

nodes.name: run_polling
nodes.summary: Deletes any webhook then loops calling getUpdates until stopped, handling timeouts and network errors with backoff and forwarding results to the handler.

nodes.name: _sleep_or_stop
nodes.summary: Sleeps for given seconds but wakes early when the stop event is set.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the Windows desktop UI (WebView2 window plus system tray icon).

nodes.name: icon_images.py
nodes.summary: Draws the bot application and tray icons with Pillow, so no image files are needed in the repo.

nodes.name: tray_icon.py
nodes.summary: System tray icon built on pystray, with a dynamic menu for toggling and restarting the bot, updates, VPS handover, autostart and quitting.

nodes.name: windows_autostart.py
nodes.summary: Manages the HKCU Run registry entry that launches the app in the tray with the bot on at Windows login, including migration of stale entries.

nodes.name: make_icon
nodes.summary: Renders a rounded blue square with a white Z at 4x supersampling, optionally adds a status dot, and downsamples to the requested size.

nodes.name: write_ico
nodes.summary: Writes a multi-resolution .ico file for the executable build.

nodes.name: Tray
nodes.summary: Wraps a pystray Icon whose menu items and enablement are driven by Desktop state; refreshes icon/title on bot state change, shows notifications and toggles Windows autostart.

nodes.name: command
nodes.summary: Builds the Run-key command line, using the frozen executable or pythonw -m bot when run from source.

nodes.name: is_enabled
nodes.summary: Returns whether the registry Run entry exists and matches the current command, False off Windows.

nodes.name: set_enabled
nodes.summary: Creates or deletes the Run registry value for autostart; raises OSError off Windows.

nodes.name: migrate
nodes.summary: Repoints an existing autostart entry to the current launch command without enabling it if absent.

nodes.name: schedule_web.py

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and PROJECT_MAP, which describe the Zalo assistant bot: installation, first run, the ZaloBot app and the web/VPS features. PROJECT_MAP gives an architecture matrix and a task-to-file lookup, a roadmap for the rest of this tour.

tour.title: Entry Points and CLI
tour.description: python -m bot starts src/bot/__main__.py, which delegates to command_line.py, the argparse CLI with subcommands such as run, gui, console, login, update and admin. It has high fan-out, wiring together most subsystems. Note that pyproject.toml declares a console script 'zalo-bot = bot.cli:main', but src/bot/cli.py does not exist, so that entry is stale; the working paths are python -m bot and the packaging entry zalobot_entry.py.

tour.title: Settings and Userdata Paths
tour.description: config.py (fan-in 17) loads Settings from environment variables and settings.env, and userdata_paths.py defines the APP_HOME and userdata folder layout. Nearly every later module depends on these two, so they are the shared foundation. The env.example template lists the available options.

tour.title: Shared Helpers and Storage
tour.description: Small helpers like vietnam_time (fixed UTC+7) and text_fold (accent-free matching) are widely imported leaf modules. The storage package builds on text_files' atomic writes to provide per-chat data stores, and process_lock prevents two bot processes from sharing one data directory.

tour.title: Receiving Zalo Messages
tour.description: The zalo package normalizes incoming payloads into IncomingMessage and talks to the Zalo Bot Platform through an httpx client. Messages arrive by long polling or the FastAPI webhook receiver, while personal_account and qr_login support running on a personal account. These modules feed the handler in the next step.

tour.title: Message Handling Core
tour.description: message_handler.py is the Bot orchestrator: it receives payloads and applies filtering, roles, rate limiting and owner commands before invoking the agent. It builds on message_filter, roles and owner_commands, and on the storage and helpers from earlier steps.

tour.title: Gemini Agent and Tools
tour.description: GeminiAgent runs a bounded function-calling loop with retries, using a system prompt built from SYSTEM.md and MEMORY.md. The tool registry auto-discovers tool modules such as assign_events and schedule_web, so new abilities can be added by dropping in a file.
tour.languageLesson: Function calling lets the model request a named tool with structured arguments; the host runs it and feeds the result back. Capping the number of rounds keeps the loop bounded.

tour.title: System Services and Remote Control
tour.description: The system package manages background processes, first-run setup, auto-update, and the local-to-VPS link through remote_server, remote_config and handover. bot_process uses lock and PID files, and handover moves the bot's data between a local machine and a VPS. docs/vps-dieu-khien.md explains this control flow.

tour.title: Admin Web Server and UI
tour.description: admin_web_server.py is a FastAPI server bound to localhost with authenticated /api routes, backed by admin_sessions and settings_file, which edits the .env file atomically. The static single-page admin UI (index.html, admin_page.js, theme CSS) talks to these routes.

tour.title: Desktop App
tour.description: desktop_app.py shows the admin UI in a WebView2 window with a system tray icon from pystray. Icons are drawn with Pillow, and windows_autostart registers launch at Windows login, so the whole bot becomes a desktop app.

tour.title: Packaging and Deployment
tour.description: build-exe.ps1 and ZaloBot.spec build the one-file ZaloBot.exe with PyInstaller, and check_secrets.py scans the output for forbidden files. ZaloBot.cmd bootstraps a venv for source installs, while run-forever.ps1 and install-task.ps1 keep the bot running via Task Scheduler.
tour.languageLesson: A PyInstaller .spec file is Python code describing the entry script, bundled data and output mode, so the build is repeatable.

tour.title: Tests and Further Docs
tour.description: conftest.py supplies fakes (FakeZalo, FakeAgent, FakeWeb) used across the suite, and test_bot.py exercises the handler end to end. docs/lenh-zalo.md documents the chat commands for each role and PLAN.md records design decisions.
